messages:
Ben Tran: Hi folks — first week! Quick QA: I enrolled my personal Mac in Jamf via SSO but the 'Redwood Device Profile' doesn't show up in Settings > Profiles. PhishSim invite came through; when's the window? Also do I need to FileVault/erase? Thanks!

Leah (People Ops): Welcome Ben! No need to wipe for personal devices. We require MDM + FileVault + 2FA. PhishSim is next Tue (2026-03-31) and due EOD Fri. Link: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/device-enroll. If Jamf profile missing, try sign out/in SSO or reinstall the enrollment package.

Hector (Security): Hi Ben — run this to check profiles: `profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo profiles show`. If not enrolled, reinstall via SSO link above. To enable FileVault: ```sudo fdesetup enable -user ben.tran@redwood.com``` or use System Preferences > Security & Privacy > FileVault. For personal devices we require escrow: open Jamf Self Service -> Security -> 'Escrow Key' and confirm. Ping me if you're blocked.

IT Helpdesk: If you'd rather avoid personal device, we can ship a loaner. Ping @ops-swag with size/details. Also please attach a photo of your device serial in the ticket.

onboarding-bot: Device enrollment check: No Jamf profile detected for ben.tran@redwood.com. Ticket #INC-2026-487 created for IT Helpdesk.

Maya (SRE): Also add YubiKey to your 2FA methods if you have one. If using company VPN, make sure SSO prompt appears on first connect (sometimes suppressed after partial enroll).

Ben Tran: Thanks all — ran `profiles status` and it returned 'No enrollment'. Re-ran SSO installer and now I see 'Redwood Device Profile'. Onboarding-bot still shows old status — /cc Hector for escrow step.

Hector (Security): Got it. I confirmed escrow recorded. You're good. PhishSim: expect a short simulated phishing email next Tue — tip: hover links and report with 'Report Phish' button. We'll grade completion in LMS.

Leah (People Ops): Adding phishsim enrollment deadline to your onboarding checklist. Welcome to the team :tada:
